title: ChatGPT automation: How to use the Zapier ChatGPT integration (GPT-6 + more)
summary: With Zapier, you can add ChatGPT-powered steps to your existing workflows, or securely access and take action in thousands of apps without ever leaving the chat window.
body_markdown: You can also use the dedicated[Zapier ChatGPT integration](https://zapier.com/apps/chatgpt/integrations) to add a ChatGPT step to your workflow (using your own OpenAI account). But we recommend using AI by Zapier instead: it offers more powerful features with prompt testing, knowledge sources, and agentic tool calling. Plus, it allows you to skip the token cost and offers more flexibility since you can easily switch to another AI model without rebuilding your workflow.
